question: Does the Gateway owner approve this behavior-neutral ownership split after the final merge-result CI completes?
rationale: The PR changes the internal boundaries of operator-critical reload, restart, channel, and managed-secret paths and is explicitly labeled for maintainer review; only an owner can accept the resulting long-term module boundaries.

options.title: Approve after final CI
options.body: Confirm that the facade and extracted modules preserve the intended reload ownership boundaries once the remaining required checks are green.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Ask for any ownership seam that should remain colocated before accepting the new internal module boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve after final CI
recommendation.body: Confirm that the facade and extracted modules preserve the intended reload ownership boundaries once the remaining required checks are green.
